title: TLDT(NRG) Official
description: The server of the disruptive random FPS modpack "TRACING LIGHT · DARK TIDE"
body:
> **Tired of piling up a bunch of gun modules but never having the chance to play with them one by one?** > **Is manual gun selection tiring and also disrupts the fairness of the battle?** ### This subversive random FPS Modpack hits the nail on the head! > Each respawn **_automatically unlocks a random weapon._** There is no need to manually toss and turn a large number of weapons to experience. **_Fair competition + all guns play_** one click to unlock, and **the gunfight fun is full!** > [看不懂的用浏览器自带的翻译器翻译一下就可以看啦~] (ฅ>ω<*ฅ) ![NRG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa889bdfa7bb093d6f05aedcb5eaf9ff5f9c2b74_0.webp) ## ❗ATTENTION
‼️[新人必看]Notice Before Download - 一些小更新直接去[NRGD数据包](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nrgd).下载然后替换就可以了。只需要服务器端进行替换。 - 该服务器最多支持8人游玩。 - 所以，请关注最新的数据包更新！ --- - This modpack **will not have frequent updates** in the future. For _**bug fixes and feature updates**_, please **refer to [NRG datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nrgd).** - _Before you download, please **read the changelog first** to avoid unnecessary problems._ - _**To update**, please **download the latest [datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nrgd)** and **REPLACE** it in the "**datapack**" folder of your world"**Summit**"._ - _So, please keep an eye on **the latest datapack version** for the best experience!_
![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## 🔥 Immersive gunfight experience This game has a total of **10 maps**, three for team matches and three for individual matches. There are also several special gamemodes too. Among them, each individual match venue has **8 different spawn points**. _Each time you are respawn, you will obtain **different weapons and attachments.** Of course, the **position** of each spawn is also different._ ![Summit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcc4f15778b0c2090a211d7c8cfa29f6d45ca244_0.webp) ![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## 💥 Countless weapons ![firearms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45faeffce78d2976342ccd3af6a07a79f356b71d_0.webp) - **400+** firearms, each hand-tuned for balance. - **500+** attachments,letting you forge your perfect weapon. - All the weapons come from [TACZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) and its accessory packs. - **10+** different modern vehicles, derived from [SUPERB WARFARE](https://modrinth.com/mod/superb-warfare), the modeling is just as good as the physics! - Datapack-Driven Customization—tweak every variable with **VS Code**. ![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## 🧬 Built for Control
[极致优化]Ultimate optimization 客户端做过极致优化；经测试，核显最高帧率800，游戏时平均帧率500。 服务端所有功能均通过原创数据包实现。尽可能的减少了每刻的运算，对服务端配置要求低。 --- Admin-Friendly commands for effortless server management. [the control room (gif)](https://easylink.cc/w00ckt) _All the game functions are implemented through datapacks, so it's very **lightweight!**_
![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## 💓玩法列表 | 现有模式 | 游戏目标 | 支持人数 | |--------------------- |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |---------- | | 团队死斗(TDM) | 在15分钟内尽全力淘汰更多的对手 | 不限 | | 自由乱斗(FFA) | 在15分钟内尽全力淘汰更多的对手 | 2-8 人 | | 团队-极限(ONELIFE) | 用自己仅有的一条生命，
最先赢下5个回合的队伍获胜 | 不限 | | 疾速追杀(HUNT) | 幸存者选择躲避或对抗,保全性命;
猎人在15分钟内淘汰所有幸存者;
幸存者被淘汰后将加入猎人队伍 | 不限 | | 刀战(KNIFE) | 在15分钟内尽全力淘汰更多的对手,
但是你只有一把刀和一颗雷 | 2-8 人 | | 火箭空战(ROCKET) | 在15分钟内尽全力淘汰更多的对手
享受空战的快乐！ | 2-8 人 | ![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## 🎯Core gameplay and competition process
[比赛流程]competition process 1. 自动将所有玩家分成两队（仅在团队模式下）。 2. 自动通知玩家比赛的信息，如比赛地点和模式。 3. 随机传送玩家到比赛场地。团队模式中的出生点是固定的，而在单人模式中，有8个随机刷出点。 4. 所有玩家重生后将获得3秒无敌效果，80点血量，并将获得随机武器和附件。 5. 在比赛过程中，每2分钟玩家将获得自己选择的额外物品。有载具的地图，载具将每4分钟刷新一次。 6. 比赛结束后，将自动排名，并公布比赛结果。初始化所有地图，等待下一个比赛。 --- 1. The game will automatically divide all players into two teams (only in team mode). 2. Automatically notify players of the competition information, such as the competition location and mode. **The player's goal is to eliminate as many opponents as possible within 15 minutes.** 3. Randomly teleport players to the competition venue. In the team mode, the spawn points are fixed, while in the single-player mode, there are 8 random spawn points. 4. All players who are reborn will receive a 3-second invincibility effect, 80 health points, and random weapons and accessories. 5. During the competition, players will receive additional items of their choice every two minutes. The vehicle will refresh every four minutes. 6. After the competition, the contestants will be automatically ranked and the competition results will be announced. Initialize all the maps and wait for the next game.
![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png) ## ℹ️ Notice
[资源复用权限]About resource reuse 除了地图和所有的枪械包、武器包，整合包的内容可以进行非商业复用和转载。 整合包里的武器包和地图均可以去模组社区寻找。 --- **If you just want to implement the core functions of the random gunfight and don't want to use my map and gunpacks, please download my [datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nrgd).** **If you have downloaded this modpack, please refer to the following precautions:** 1. Just have all the players participating in the game download and install the compressed package, and then open LAN World on the host. 2. Do not modify the game files at will, otherwise the online connection may fail due to file mismatch. 3. I has not developed any anti-cheating system, so it is recommended that you play it with your "tech-free" friends.
![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf2f3fa5e61c8f4db010dd9b51f00d58feff62b9.png)
